name: persisted-v9-rank-guard-alignment-diagnostic
purpose: Determine descriptively whether the fold with the worst C1/B0 effective-rank ratio also shows a C1 top-1 loss, using only frozen v9 artifacts.

single_analysis.performance: For each outer fold and seed, compute exact persisted C1 minus B0 top-1, top-3 and macro top-1; then pool the three seeds per fold.
single_analysis.rank: For each outer fold, report the minimum and mean persisted C1/B0 effective-rank ratio across the three seeds.
single_analysis.association: Report Pearson and Spearman association between the five fold-level top-1 deltas and minimum rank ratios as descriptive values only.
single_analysis.worst_rank_fold: Identify the fold with the lowest minimum rank ratio and report its top-1 delta.

interpretation.aligned: Worst-rank fold has negative C1-B0 top-1 delta; the guard is directionally aligned with measured harm on that fold.
interpretation.not_aligned: Worst-rank fold has non-negative C1-B0 top-1 delta; the guard did not predict measured harm on its worst fold.
interpretation.limits: Five folds are insufficient for inferential correlation; the diagnostic cannot relax or retrospectively alter any existing gate.

decision_use: Return to Council after the diagnostic to choose exactly one preregistered model factor: alpha=0.5 interpolation or a C1 readout covariance/orthogonality penalty.
